mapper.select: SELECT c.*, COUNT(p.id) AS post_count FROM category c LEFT JOIN post p ON p.category_id = c.id AND p.status = 1 AND p.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category (name, slug, parent_id, sort) VALUES (#{name}, #{slug}, #{parentId}, #{sort})
